description: Check a credential signed by MCC Solutions: the company's own (notary commission, E&O, certifications, from /credentials) or a contractor's clearance credential (shared by the contractor or returned by firm_order_status), including the no-personal-details version (…/clearance.jwt: yes or no for commission, E&O, background check and agreement, no name or dates). Give the credential as a compact JWT or its link on mcc-solutionsnj.com. Returns whether the signature matches the site's did:web key (so it wasn't altered), whether it's within its dates, and for contractors whether they're cleared right now.

credential.description: The vc+jwt text, or a link like https://mcc-solutionsnj.com/credentials/contractors/<id>.jwt

name: verify_credential
title: Verify an MCC Solutions credential
